main.description: The user's non-custodial EVM wallet: one passkey-PRF-encrypted copy of the same secp256k1 private key per credential. Single record at rkey 'self'.

address.description: 0x-prefixed EVM address derived from the wallet key.

linkSig.description: Signature over the at.tessera.wallet.link.v1:<did> message, binding the address to the DID.

credentialId.description: base64url id of the passkey credential this copy is encrypted for.

prfSalt.description: base64url PRF eval salt used to derive the encryption key.

ciphertext.description: base64url AES-GCM ciphertext of the secp256k1 private key.
